neqsim.neqsimpython.NeqSimJVMError: Failed to start Java Virtual Machine (JVM).

Common solutions:
1. Install Java JDK 17+ from https://adoptium.net/
2. Ensure JAVA_HOME environment variable is set
3. Ensure 64-bit Python matches 64-bit Java (or 32-bit with 32-bit)

See: https://github.com/equinor/neqsim-python#prerequisites
